subject: prd/e2e-verification
statement: When an e2e design doc is submitted to e2e-review, the skill shall run blind, fresh-context lens reviewers over one shared context pack and emit closable findings in a review report.
rationale: the established reviewer-program shape, applied to the e2e design
fit_criterion: on a fixture doc, e2e-review emits a review report of closable findings (each naming its own acceptance condition); the report validates against the review-report schema it adopts
